text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Can I join you?

text_block_list.name: Scarlet and Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It's no fair.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This is the big clash everything's been
building toward. More and more big
names keep joining.
These are electric
eel levels of excitement.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I want in on it too. So please, let me be
a part of
it with you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Let you be a part of it?
...Machan. I've
had my eye on you as someone to
watch
out for this whole time.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Same. I mean, ya gotta keep an eye out
for
threats.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: You have? Really?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. And social media blew up when
word got
out that you were gonna be
runnin'.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Wh-what? It did?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Obviously, I can't wait to see the rivals
clash, but Aston Machan and tons of
other great runners are
gonna be there
too."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"It's really anyone's race. There's no
telling who's
going to come out on top."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Pah, they're all wrong! I'm the best there
is,
period!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huhhh?! Excuse you! I'm the best there is! I'm number one!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...So that's what everyone's been
thinking. And
here I was, completely
oblivious.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But these are great expectations. I'll be

absolutely sure to live up to them.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If it's anyone's race to win,
I have to win it so
soundly that everyone says there's
no other way it
could've gone.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to beat both of you... by a
mile.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: By a mile, hm? Well put. But I'm afraid that's my line!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Don't get too excited. Everyone'll be
eatin' outta
the palm of my hand by the
time this is over.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What's so funny, Machan?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Nothing... I'm just happy to be included.

text_block_list.name: Scarlet and Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Let's create a legend—all of us,
together.
